module.name: Serewater March · Client study
module.description: Installed situations share this persistent world.

entities.name: Vesper, ferry clerk and burial trustee
Oren, surveyor waiting for a safe escort
The White Hound, cold-altered burial guardian
The ember seal is a foundry lesson: one companion can learn its fire invocation permanently. Its origin does not grant ownership of the burials.

actions.name: Travel to {destination}
actions.report: You follow the route and arrive at the next place. People and dangers continue while you travel.

actions.name: Give {recipient} one coin
actions.report: You hand over one coin. It is now in the recipient’s purse.

actions.name: Give {recipient} one ration
actions.report: You offer a ration and step back. The recipient now owns it; what they do next is their decision.

actions.name: Eat a ration
actions.report: The company shares a ration. This satisfies hunger but does not restore health or mana.

actions.name: Collect one {goods} from {store}
actions.report: You collect one unit from the available stock. It is now carried by the company.

actions.name: Deposit one {goods} in {store}
actions.report: You deposit what the company was carrying. The stock increases and your hands are free.

actions.name: Tell {recipient}: {statement}
actions.report: You explain what the evidence establishes. The listener accepts your account and sets aside a conflicting assumption; their next choices remain their own.

actions.name: Ask {informant} about {topic}
actions.description: Ask about an offered topic. The speaker shares an established fact they actually know.
actions.report: The speaker shares an account they know. You record it in your journal.

actions.name: Destroy {witness}
actions.report: You destroy this source of evidence. Existing knowledge and other sources remain.

actions.name: Have {caster} use {technique} on {recipient}
actions.description: Use a known healing or cleansing ability outside combat. Its normal mana cost is paid; combat cooldowns do not apply.
actions.report: You pause to tend a companion. The same spell effects and mana costs apply here as in battle.

actions.name: Rest and recover at {site}
actions.description: Spend six hours and one shared ration at a safe shelter. Living companions recover HP and mana; bleeding is treated. Poison and death remain. Other people and deadlines continue.
actions.report: You settle in for six hours, sharing a ration and tending your wounds. The world continues outside.

actions.name: Accept {gift} for {recipient}
actions.report: The chosen companion studies the one-use lesson. Its power is spent, but the learned ability remains available on future expeditions.

actions.name: Why are people going to Censer Hill?
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'The flood broke the ferry chain. The foundry has bronze enough for a new one, but those are our families' burial galleries now. My brother went with the salvagers. I need him back; I will not buy a bridge with stolen bones. Speak to Oren before you decide what to take.'
actions.speaker: censer__vesper

actions.name: What can we prepare here?
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'The inn has beds and your company has provisions. Rest here costs a ration and six hours. A cleric can heal wounds on the road. You will need to choose how far to go before turning back. Ask what the people up there claim before deciding what is yours to take.'
actions.speaker: censer__vesper

actions.name: What happened to the expedition?
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'We split over the bronze. The others went farther down. The hound guards the lower gallery: fire can hurt it, cold scarcely does, and its howl can stun. You can turn back. There is also an old lesson seal below; taking that does not mend the ferry or recover my companions.' Oren folds his survey. 'I can tell you what I saw. I cannot promise what lies beyond.'
actions.speaker: censer__oren

observations.text: Rain ticks on the ferry office roof. Beyond the landing, a broken chain hangs in the brown water. Vesper keeps a list of the people who went up to Censer Hill. Willow country rises west of the last houses.

Willow roots grip the raised stone path. Reed warblers call from last year's stems. Above the flood line stands the old foundry: a long roof, an empty bell-frame, and a dark receiving door. You can continue or return before committing supplies.
Someone has swept a dry square among the fallen plaster. Oren sits beside a measuring staff. The broad passage descends toward the singers' stair. Light from the doorway remains at your back.
Worn steps turn beneath a row of empty niches. A cold draught rises from the lower ossuary. Water has left a pale line across the lowest step. The air smells of limestone and old charcoal.

The White Hound stands between chalk burial slabs. Cold has bleached its coat. Its rime bite can weaken; its howl can stun. A small ember seal rests in a side niche, beside its firing instructions. The hound watches the burial slabs. The stair remains behind you.

The White Hound lies still. The crypt does not reset: the injuries and death are part of this campaign. The burial slabs remain undisturbed. The ember seal can be read and accepted if it is still here.
The seal has crumbled. Its invocation belongs to the companion who learned it, and will remain available in future encounters. Return to Reedwake to recover; nothing ends the campaign here.

installations.name: Censer Hill — client study: Censer Hill interface fixture
